$Comment: The Gravekeeper, an old man who stands near Old Jack in the Forgotten Temple while Hallow's Eve runs and on every full moon, and during Hallow's Eve sends whoever asks into the Headless Horseman's graveyard. A thin Variant: Template_Zig_QuestGiver, shipped by Ziggfreed's CommonLib, holds the whole body (standing still, invulnerable, watching, the press-F action), and this file only says how he looks and reads. Modify may name only the five parameters that template declares: Appearance, NameTranslationKey, Weapons, OffHand and DefaultOffHandSlot. Naming anything else makes the game refuse the whole role, and the only sign in game is a Gravekeeper who never appears. Appearance is this pack's own model (Models/Hallows_Eve/NPC/Hallows_Eve_Gravekeeper.json), built from the game's own character pieces. Weapons puts a shovel in his right hand; OffHand puts a lantern in his left, and DefaultOffHandSlot 0 is what makes him hold it, since without it the lantern stays stowed. NameTranslationKey is his nameplate, in this pack's npcs.lang. Pressing F opens what his placement authors under Interact, his conversation: NpcPlacements/Hallows_Eve_Gravekeeper_Temple.json during Hallow's Eve, and Hallows_Eve_Gravekeeper_Restless_Temple.json on a full moon outside it; a Gravekeeper nothing placed, such as one spawned by command, opens the template's quest list instead.
